## CI red at `d139941` on the objectui#10645 test only, so this PR waits for that fix

`domain:ui` seat 5, `session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`, 2026-09-25T15:46Z. The at-tier contract review of this head PASSed; its record follows. One required check is red:
- **The check:** `Test (shard 2/8)` (job `108133385997`), with a single failing file, `apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx:299`. It is the cold-lazy timing race objectui#10645 records, and the same case is red today on PR objectui#10635, PR objectui#10651 and PR objectui#10644.
- **Why it is not this PR's:** that file imports nothing from `@object-ui/fields`, and this PR touches only `ImageField.tsx`, its pin and its changeset.
- **What happens next:** objectui#10645 is now graded p1, and this seat claims its test-only fix. This PR stays a draft until that fix is on `main`. It then takes one `origin/main` merge and a fresh ACCEPT. It does not widen.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d139941957e36e462fd316608e2c94bf74ec01e7`

Read: card objectui#10637 (body, triage `5833723730`, claim `5834260043`; the `os-dev-report` was not used as evidence), origin card objectui#10493, PR objectui#10660 body and file list, check-runs at the head, the diff `refs/review/main..refs/review/pr-10660` (merge-base `785d3a7` = current `origin/main`), AGENTS.md 版本号策略, `.changeset/config.json`, and the installed `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0` `isFileIdToken`. Read-only; no GitHub writes.

### ① Derived judgments

Diff vs merge-base: 3 files, +248 −1. `packages/fields/src/widgets/ImageField.tsx` (+9 −1), `packages/fields/src/widgets/ImageField.imageAlt-10637.test.tsx` (new, 222 lines), `.changeset/10637-image-alt-translated.md` (new, 17 lines). `file-value.ts` and `ImageLightbox.tsx` are untouched, as the boundary requires.

**The one source change.** `ImageField.tsx:92` — `readFileValues(value, 'Image')` becomes `readFileValues(value, '')`, plus the comment at `:84-91`. RIGHT against the triage 「Pass no fallback name into `readFileValues`」 and 「follow the cell renderer」: the cell's `displayableImagesOf` at `packages/fields/src/index.tsx:2261-2262` passes exactly `''`. With an empty fallback, `readFileValue` (`file-value.ts:150-186`) yields `name: ''` for a bare id (`:158`), for a `data:` URI (`:160`, `nameFromUrl` gives `undefined` since objectui#10493), and for an object with no `name`/`original_name`/URL segment (`:170-174`); a value with its own name keeps it (`:170-172`). No other line of the widget changed, and no other line needed to: every reader below already has an `||` fallback.

**Every reader of a view's `name` in `ImageField`, and what a nameless value now shows** (checked one by one, as the card-specific boundary asks):

| Reader | Head line | Nameless value, before | Nameless value, after | Judgment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| read-only thumbnail `img` alt | `ImageField.tsx:167` | `Image` | `t('fields.image.imageAlt', { index })` | asked (「take the translated `fields.image.imageAlt`」) — right |
| read-only enlarge button `aria-label` | `:163` | `fields.image.enlarge` embedding `Image` | `fields.image.enlarge` embedding the translated alt | asked (the card's second landing site) — right |
| edit-mode thumbnail `img` alt | `:273` | `Image` | translated alt, indexed | asked (the card says alt in the widget; the triage says every reader) — right |
| lightbox `img` alt | `:149` builds `name: v.name`; `ImageLightbox.tsx:77` | `Image` | `t('fields.image.imageAlt', { index })` | 「the lightbox takes the same name」 — right |
| lightbox dialog title (its accessible name) | `:149`; `ImageLightbox.tsx:73` | `Image` | `t('fields.image.preview')` | see the lightbox judgment below — right |
| cropper output file name | `:144` `img.name \|\| \`image-${index}.png\`` | `Image` | `image-0.png` for the first image | disclosed side effect — see below |
| just-uploaded bare id (`withRecentUploads`, `file-value.ts:259-277`) | `:92` | its upload name | its upload name | unchanged; the recent view is keyed by id and overrides the empty name — right |

**The lightbox judgment.** The triage binds 「the lightbox takes the same name」. At the head the lightbox's image alt is the same translated `fields.image.imageAlt` string the thumbnail carries (`ImageLightbox.tsx:77`), so the image's name IS the same name. The dialog container is named by its own `DialogTitle`, which falls to `fields.image.preview` (`:73`) when the image has no name — a translated string, not the literal. That is exactly what the cell produces (the cell passes `name: undefined` at `index.tsx:2264`, and the lightbox is shared), and the cell's own pin from objectui#10493 (`packages/fields/src/__tests__/cellRenderers.dataUriAlt-10493.test.tsx:146-154`) asserted the very same split: the dialog text contains `zh.fields.image.preview`, the image alt is the translated alt. The ruling's prescribed mechanism (no fallback name in; the lightbox left alone, since the claim's file surface is `ImageField.tsx` only) necessarily yields this. Verdict: satisfies 「the lightbox takes the same name」; not a gap. Under `zh` no reader in the lightbox reads the English word.

**The cropper judgment.** `openCropper` (`ImageField.tsx:144`) already carried its own fallback `image-${index}.png`, authored for a nameless image and unreachable for the same reason the translated alt was. Removing the literal from `readFileValues` makes it reachable: the crop of a nameless image is now named `image-0.png` (a PNG name for a cropper that re-encodes to PNG) instead of the extension-less `Image`. That name flows to `maxSizeError` (`:107`), `upload`/`remember`/`fileValueForSubmit(result, name)` (`:117-119`) and the failure message (`:130`); on the reference-form submit path the name is not stored (`file-value.ts:221-222`), on the legacy-blob path it lands in `original_name` (`:223-229`, the field at `:225`). Judgment: a behaviour change the ruling's mechanism requires (「Pass no fallback name」 plus the triage's own reading that the literal leaves the widget), not a regression — the previous value was the defect's literal surfacing as a file name. It is a side effect not named by the card. It IS disclosed: PR body (the H3 table row and the paragraph 「The cropper row is a side effect of the fix…」) and the changeset (`.changeset/10637-image-alt-translated.md:16-17`). It is NOT pinned, and the body says so. The ruling's pin ask (「Pin under `zh` with a bare-id value」) is about the accessible name, so the missing cropper pin is a thinness, not a missing ask. Recorded, no FAIL.

**Asked and present:** no fallback name into `readFileValues` (`:92`) ✓; translated `fields.image.imageAlt` for a nameless value in alt and enlarge label (`:163`, `:167`, `:273`) ✓; lightbox takes the same name (`:149`, `ImageLightbox.tsx:77`) ✓; pin under `zh` with a bare-id value (test `:94-107`, `:109-116`, `:118-122`) ✓; pins beside the existing `ImageField` tests (`widgets/`, next to `ImageField.maxSize.test.tsx` and `ImageField.uploadFailure.test.tsx`) ✓; one `.changeset/10637-…md` ✓; `file-value.ts` untouched ✓ (the doc at `file-value.ts:39-43` that names the cell as an example caller stays true).

**Done but not asked:** only the 8-line explanatory comment at `ImageField.tsx:84-91`, in-scope. Two merge commits from `origin/main` (`5511043`, `d139941`) carry no diff of their own against the merge-base. Nothing else.

**Existing pins edited or deleted:** none. The diff deletes one source line only. I grepped every test on `main` that renders `ImageField` (`readonly-host-plumbing-e2e`, `widget-aria-invalid-registry-e2e`, `widget-dom-leak-e2e`, `ImageField.maxSize`, `ImageField.uploadFailure`, `uploadingScope`, `uploadingScope.hold`) and `ImageLightbox.test.tsx` for an assertion on the literal `Image` as an alt or name: zero hits, so no guard on `main` was weakened or silently broken.

**Can the new pins fail?** Yes on both legs.
- Negative leg (base tree): with `readFileValues(value, 'Image')` the six DEFECT rows fail by construction — the read-only alt is `Image` not `packAlt(zh, 1)` (`:100`); `getByRole('dialog', { name: zh.fields.image.preview })` throws because the base title is `Image` (`:112`); edit-mode alt `Image` (`:121`); data-URI alt `Image` (`:128`); the pair reads `['Image','Image']` (`:135-138`); the `en` leg reads `Image` where the pack gives `Image 1` (`:158`). The premise row and the three controls pass on both trees, so the honest base count is 6 fail / 4 pass, as the body reports.
- Lit control: `:162-172` a value with `name: 'cover.png'` keeps it in alt, enlarge label and lightbox (dialog named `cover.png`); `:174-177` an https URL is named by its last segment; `:179-221` a just-uploaded bare id keeps its upload name through `withRecentUploads`. The caricature 「every image is now named by the translated string」 fails all three.
- Premise row `:85-92` guards the locale legs: `zh` and `en` differ, and neither the zh alt nor the zh enlarge string contains `Image` (`zh.ts:238` `图片 {{index}}`, `:241` `放大 {{name}}`; `en.ts:271` `Image {{index}}`, `:274` `Enlarge {{name}}`, `:275` `Image preview`). Expected strings are pack values interpolated in the test (`:52`, `:55`), matching the i18n `{{hole}}` syntax with `escapeValue: false` (`packages/i18n/src/i18n.ts:237`).
- The bare-id rows depend on `isFileIdToken('file_a')`: the installed spec 17.4.0 defines it as `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/`, so `file_a`, `file_b`, `file_new` are ids and the `src` assertion `/api/v1/storage/files/file_a` (`file-value.ts:106-108`) holds.
- Import `@object-ui/i18n/locales` is a published subpath (`packages/i18n/package.json` exports `./locales`) with five precedent test imports in `packages/fields`, including the 10493 pin.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/10637-image-alt-translated.md:1-3` declares `'@object-ui/fields': patch`. `@object-ui/fields` is a published package in the `fixed` group (`.changeset/config.json`), so a changeset is owed and this is not the docs-only case. Against AGENTS.md 版本号策略: no `major` (the rule's only hard prohibition) ✓; `minor` is reserved for objectui's own breaking changes — this diff moves no export, prop, schema or accepted value, only the accessible-name text of a nameless image and the reachable file-name fallback, so `patch` is the right level ✓.

Changeset prose, sentence by sentence against the diff:
1. Title `:5` 「the image field widget names an image that carries no name of its own with the translated `fields.image.imageAlt`, not the literal `Image`」 — TRUE (`ImageField.tsx:92`, `:163`, `:167`, `:273`).
2. `:7-9` 「`ImageField` read its images with the untranslated literal `'Image'` as the fallback name, so a value with no name of its own (a bare `sys_file` id, or a `data:` URI) was named `Image` on every locale.」 — TRUE (base `:84`; `file-value.ts:158`, `:160`).
3. `:9-10` 「Its img alt, the read-mode enlarge button's accessible name and the lightbox it opens all read that word, and the translated `fields.image.imageAlt` fallback never ran.」 — TRUE (`:163`, `:167`, `:273`; `ImageLightbox.tsx:73`, `:77`).
4. `:12-13` 「`ImageField` now reads its images with no fallback name, as the image cell has since objectui#10493.」 — TRUE (`:92`; `index.tsx:2262`).
5. `:13-15` 「A nameless image gets the translated alt ("Image 1" in `en`, numbered by position) in read mode and edit mode, the enlarge button's name embeds that alt, and the lightbox gets the translated alt and the translated preview title.」 — TRUE (`en.ts:271`; `:163`, `:167`, `:273`; `ImageLightbox.tsx:73`, `:77`).
6. `:15` 「A value that carries a name keeps it.」 — TRUE (`file-value.ts:170-174`).
7. `:16-17` 「The cropper's output file name for a nameless image is now the widget's own fallback (`image-0.png` for the first image), where it was `Image`.」 — TRUE (`:144`).
8. `:17` 「Stored values do not change.」 — TRUE as written: the change is on the read path and rewrites no stored value. One precision note, not a falsity: a NEW crop of a nameless image submitted on the legacy-blob path now stores `original_name: 'image-0.png'` where it stored `Image` (`:119`; `file-value.ts:222-225`); the PR body discloses that path explicitly, the changeset does not spell it out.

Docs/README prose added by the diff: none (no `content/docs/**`, no README). The code comment at `ImageField.tsx:84-91` is true sentence by sentence (the lightbox mention refers to its image alt; the title's `preview` fallback is not mentioned, which is an omission, not an error). The test docblock `:9-30` is true against the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **PR body flags answered.** (a) The lightbox deviation from the claim's pin shape: judged above — the dialog is named by its title, the image by the alt; both translated, both as the cell and the 10493 cell pin; not a gap. (b) The cropper row: a disclosed, unpinned side effect the ruling's mechanism produces; not a regression; stated in body and changeset. (c) 「`file-value.ts` is not touched」 — TRUE (diff stat).
